title: Shaughnessy crests
ownership: Owner-supplied brand assets; public hosting does not grant redistribution rights.

variants.note: Exact existing portfolio derivative, with translucent vector fills strengthening small-size detail. Distinct from the supplied original mono SVG.

usage_example.title: Portfolio footer lockup
usage_example.layout_policy: Use either example as is, or customize the layout, alignment, spacing, padding, typography, colors, navigation, copyright placement, and responsive behavior to fit the consuming site's current theme. Exact reproduction is optional. Keep both the main SHAUGHV wordmark and Shaughnessy crest in the footer as a recognizable pair, preserving their relative sizing and each logo's aspect ratio. Copyright text is required. Full-viewport sites keep main at one full viewport and place the footer below it in normal flow.
usage_example.color_policy: Black and white are neutral demonstration colors, not a required palette. Choose footer colors from the consuming project's design; do not infer them from these previews or the source portfolio.

preview_contrast.inverse: White foreground on black background, selectable independently for each example.
preview_contrast.scope: Preview control only; changing contrast preserves logo dimensions, spacing, alignment, and padding. A consuming site does not need this toggle.

usage_example.sizing_policy: The documented dimensions are a proportional reference, not fixed installation sizes. Scale both logos up or down by the same factor to suit the site. Preserve the reference relationship of a 64px-high wordmark to an 80px-wide by 100px-high crest, and each logo's natural aspect ratio. Scale the 7px wordmark optical offset with the pair when using the same renderer. Gap, surrounding padding, and breakpoints are customizable.
usage_example.rendering: The examples use a static wordmark paired with a currentColor CSS mask of the footer crest; copyright is beneath them. This arrangement is optional; retain both logos and their relative sizing when customizing it.
usage_example.typography: Makira and Paper Mono; Michelangelus is not used in this source footer.

layout_variants.identity: Wordmark and crest together on the left; copyright below them, left aligned.
layout_variants.navigation: Sample About, Projects, and Tasks links on the right; stack below on small screens.

layout_variants.identity: Wordmark and crest side by side, centered horizontally; copyright beneath, centered.

full_viewport_layout.main: Keep the main experience one full viewport when the design calls for it; use min-height: 100svh with a 100vh fallback and width: 100%.
full_viewport_layout.footer: Place the footer after main in normal document flow, below the first viewport. Do not subtract its height from main or overlay controls.
full_viewport_layout.units: A full viewport is 100vh/100svh, not 1vh. Prefer width:100% to avoid 100vw scrollbar overflow. Allow content to grow when needed.
